title: 14.3% of Americans Have Money States Must Return
hook: States hold money that belongs to 14.3% of Americans.
closing: A free state search can return money you did not know was missing.
question: Have you checked your state?

segments.say: California holds 15 billion dollars in unclaimed money that still belongs to ordinary people.
States returned 4.49 billion dollars last year, while most unclaimed money kept waiting.
Unclaimed money waits for 14.3 percent of Americans, so a free search can genuinely pay off.
